== Notes ==
* Magmus only appears if your [[character]] has finished the [[Heart of the Shiverpeaks (quest)|Heart of the Shiverpeaks quest]]; otherwise, you will encounter [[Cyndr the Mountain Heart]].
* Numerous [[Jelly|Ooze]]s will pop up when Magmus is first [[aggro]]ed. Many use [[Ooze Division]], resulting in even greater numbers of foes. After breaking aggro the first time, nearly all of these can be [[pull]]ed away from Magmus, in smaller groups. These oozes are affected by the [[Fire Spout]]s in the area, and do not attempt to flee from them. It's common for more than half of the oozes to be killed by this phenomenon after 10-15 minutes without combat, and that pace can be hastened with the use of [[Edge of Extinction]].
* When Magmus has 1/4 health left it will go back to the middle and split into 10 [[Magma Blister]]s.
* Magmus is resistant to [[interrupt]]s in [[Hard mode]] and cannot be [[Daze]]d.
* Consider bringing [[Snare (tactic)|snares]] to prevent Magmus from reaching your [[Team roles|midline and backline]] and using Flame Burst and Inferno on them, such as [[knock down]]s (e.g. [["You Move Like a Dwarf!"]]) and [[Tryptophan Signet]] (its duration will not be affected by [[Natural Resistance]], which most Eye of the North bosses have).

==Trivia==
*Along with [[Freezie]], [[Fronis Irontoe]], [[Maz Scourgeheart]], and [[Varny the Zealot]], Magmus is one of the only dungeon end foes to be a boss (all others are [[boss-like foes]]).
**Freezie only has monster skills, Fronis is fought while [[Brawling]], and Maz is only accessible before [[the Searing]], so Magmus and Varny are the only dungeon end foes whose skills can be [[Signet of Capture|capture]]d.
